name: Auroom Cala Glass Mini Sauna (Aspen)
description: Auroom Cala Glass Mini Sauna The Auroom Cala Glass Mini Sauna Kit offers a luxurious and spa-quality sauna experience in the comfort of your own home. Designed for one person, this individual sauna is both easy to use and cost-effective, with a simple and low energy setup. Featuring a stunning front glass wall and door, the Cala Glass Mini Sauna Kit is the ideal choice for creating a serene sauna environment in your home. Experience the ultimate in relaxation with the Auroom Cala Glass Mini Sauna, crafted from high-quality northern European aspen wood. This 1-person sauna boasts a full-glass front and 2-tier seating for comfort and enjoyment. Its smooth texture and elegant light tone, along with its seamless design, showcase the exceptional craftsmanship of a personalized sauna experience. The Auroom Cala Glass Mini Sauna (Aspen) boasts high-quality features, including a durable stainless and wood door pull, strong hinges, and a front wall made of tempered glass. Aspen, a top sauna wood with exceptional thermal properties, provides a splinter-free and long-lasting sauna experience. The Sauna heater is sold separately. Installation is a breeze. This DIY cabin can be assembled in a matter of 3-4 hours with two people to help. The Auroom Cala Glass Mini 1 Person Indoor Sauna features a premium glass entryway with a sophisticated metal-wood handle, delivering both style and functionality. Maximize your sauna enjoyment with a luxurious glass wall. Create a tranquil and peaceful atmosphere for relaxation. Its slim dimensions help it fit effortlessly into any space, making it ideal for small rooms An elegant finish crafted from premium wood, Horizontal Aspen/Thermo-Aspen exterior and interior paneling (measuring 0.59"x 3.54" STP) completes the effect. Optimal Seating Position. A flat bench and footrest provide comfort and ease during the sauna session. An embedded LED Light Strip in the backrest creates a soothing ambiance. For added peace of mind, the heater guard has been designed to blend with the sauna's internal structure. Maximize your sauna session with the included accessories. Bucket + Ladle, Thermometer + Hygrometer, Sand Timer, Aroma Set, Sauna Hat and Sauna Pillow. If you do not receive tracking information from us within six business days of your order, feel free to follow up with us at customercare@nordicasauna.com . If your item(s) do arrive damaged please send photos to customercare@nordicasauna.com and we will process an insurance claim on your behalf.
